title: 'Here's The Book': Trump Shows Off Book Of His 'Accomplishments' Before Throwing It On The Ground
transcript: Here's the book. These are all things we have.
shows: Trump at the White House podium holding up a thick bound book labeled 'The White House / Accomplishments / AS OF JANUARY 20, 2026'

title: Trump holds up “Minnesota worst of the worst” arrests at White House briefing | Jan. 20, 2026
transcript: All the page, after page, after page, individual things.
shows: Trump at the podium gesturing while describing the accomplishments book, AP watermark top-right

title: Trump holds up “Minnesota worst of the worst” arrests at White House briefing | Jan. 20, 2026

title: Trump holds up “Minnesota worst of the worst” arrests at White House briefing | Jan. 20, 2026
